about: Test questions for Ask (src/chat/chat.mjs). Each has what the search should and shouldn't do; scripts/ask-eval.mjs runs them all and scores the answers. Add the questions that matter to you, especially ones Ask got wrong. Checks: with (catalog ids the search must use), notWith (ids it must not use), course, cuisine, diet, maxTime (time filter at most this), noQ (no dish words), q (dish words must include this), noSearch (shows nothing, for questions that aren't recipe searches), noNames (the reply must not contain these words).
